newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Gas explosion kills three Romanian coalminers.
newsitem.headline: Gas explosion kills three Romanian coalminers.

text.p: An explosion triggered by a gas leak killed three miners and injured 13 on Monday in western Romania's Jiu Valley coal field, the industry ministry said.
Most of the injured were taken by helicopter to hospitals in the city of Timisoara, near the border with Serbia and Hungary. An inquiry was launched into the cause of the blast.

Coal miners' unions often complain about difficult conditions, including poor ventilation, obsolete devices to detect gas leaks and low quality explosives which they say have caused many fatal accidents.
